description: This file defines the CandidateVacancyDecorator class, which provides a decorator pattern implementation for the CandidateVacancy entity. It includes methods to set vacancy and candidate references by ID, and to retrieve the status of the candidate vacancy with mapping and formatting.

classes.name: CandidateVacancyDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for CandidateVacancy entity, providing methods to associate vacancies and candidates by ID and retrieve vacancy status information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the vacancy for the candidate vacancy using a vacancy ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the candidate for the candidate vacancy using a candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyStatus
methods.description: Returns an array with the status ID and label for the candidate vacancy.
